title: codemap/1 registry
description: Closes the vocabulary of flow names and scopes enforcement. Steps are never declared here — they are derived from the code (SPEC.md §1.1, §8).

specVersion.description: A tool older than the registry refuses to run (§9).

flows.description: Declared flow names. A cm:flow naming anything absent from this list is CM101.

externals.description: Out-of-tree systems a cm:edge may target as external:<name>/<path>. Only the NAME is verifiable — the path inside it is not in the tree, so nothing checks it (SPEC.md §4, §8). An undeclared name is CM107.

advisory.description: Run the advisory tier (CM301) in a --tier all run. Warning-only and never gating; off by default because its false-positive rate is unmeasured (SPEC.md §7.1).

drain.description: Raise CM013 on a run with a base revision: a file whose code changed while none of its frozen prose debt fell (SPEC.md §8). On by default — it is the only path by which the baseline drains from work that was happening anyway.

languages.description: Per-language overrides, keyed by profile id: ts, go, php, py, rust, sql, sh, yaml.
